entries: After {DISASTER:strikes}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, comes back to {place} to close the house, and finds {SOMEONE:human,!plural} still waiting at {landmark:built}.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, hears {SOMEONE:human,!plural} at {landmark:built} every night, and must learn {DEADLINE} what was left unsaid.
In {place}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, inherits {THING} and a presence that stays until {first} can {DO_PERSON:inner} {CLOSE:human}.
When {THING:portable} turns up {HIDING}, {first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, begins to hear {SOMEONE:human,!plural} humming at {landmark:built}.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, is asked to {DO_THING} {THING} for {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and learns that the dead wait.
A {trait} {job} named {first} rents {landmark:built} in {place}, where {DISASTER} was never mourned and {SOMEONE:human,!plural} still listens.
Every {season}, {SOMEONE:human,!plural} returns to {landmark:built}, and {first}, a {trait} {job}, must decide whether to let go.
At {landmark:built}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, finds {THING:portable} {HIDING} and a voice asking for {PRIZE:!inner}.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, has not spoken of {DISASTER} for years, until {SOMEONE:human,!plural} begins to appear {MANNER}.
Grieving {CLOSE:human}, {first}, a {trait} {job}, takes a post in {place} and finds that {landmark:built} remembers {DISASTER}.
The {rival} wants {landmark:built} sold, but {first}, a {trait} {job}, hears {SOMEONE:human,!plural} asking to stay.
